stateNote: Bring a few inches of water to a boil in a pot. Place a steamer basket or other platform in the pot to elevate the wrapped ekuru above the water. Add the wrapped ekuru, cover, and steam for 45 minutes. Make sure the water doesn't evaporate; if it's boiling up, add a drop of red oil to the water.

issues.note: no temperature given; used the middle of steam's typical range
